title: Thornback Elder

steps.prompt: A huge old boar-like beast the size of a cart, a tall ridge of long wooden thorns and small saplings growing along its back, grey mossy fur, cracked bark tusks, one scarred eye, side-on three-quarter view. A single creature alone, centred, whole body in frame with margin, neutral standing pose, three-quarter front view, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no scenery. High-end anime fantasy RPG key visual, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, detailed ornate equipment with engraved metal, layered cloth and leather, realistic proportions, expressive anime faces, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, original design, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 20000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 2048 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 2.6 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/f1/con_thornback_elder.png. The concept image went through TRELLIS.2 (BiRefNet cut-out, shape, texture, remesh, reduce to about 40,000 triangles, unwrap, bake), then Blender reduced it to the budget and re-baked the texture. Measured: source_tris=19900 final_tris=19900 dims=1.606x2.600x1.887 tex=2048. Made with TRELLIS.2 at the coarse remesh setting (192), which keeps spiky, furry and thatched shapes whole. Judged from a rendered preview only; not yet seen in the headset.
